claim: Hiša Franko guesthouse is in an 1861 building at Staro selo 1, ~3 km from Kobarid bus station, rooms reserved exclusively for dining guests and bookable one night only, no TVs, minimal electronics.
quote: Hiša Franko is housed in a countryside guesthouse built in 1861... reserved exclusively for guests dining at the restaurant... available for one night only.

claim: Hiša Franko offers 10 rooms plus a 4-room depandance — 14 rooms / 28 beds total.
Nebesa Chalets is four chalets for two persons at Livek 39, ~1000 m elevation overlooking the Julian Alps and Soča valley; awarded the 2025 MICHELIN Key; per-stay packages run €1,650–€1,930.
quote: Four chalets for two persons captured on a panoramic deck between the sky and earth... awarded the 2025 MICHELIN Key... Winter: €1,650 / Summer: €1,930.

claim: Nebesa Chalets is recognised by the MICHELIN Guide as a Key-rated stay, the Guide's hotel-side equivalent of a star.
quote: Nebesa Chalets — Kobarid — Book a MICHELIN Guide Hotel.

claim: Hotel Dobra Vila Bovec occupies a historic former telephone central office, has 11 Art Deco rooms with a library, fireplace, wine boutique, and a 1932 vintage motorcycle in the window; ~200 m from Bovec centre.
quote: Hotel occupies a 'historic telephone central office'... 11 rooms... Art Deco... book-lined shelves... 1932 vintage motorcycle displayed in a window... within only 200 metres from the centre of Bovec.

claim: Tourist Farm Žvanč is a Koren-family organic dairy farm at Drežniške Ravne 33 (600 m elevation), with rooms priced €70–€90 per night for two (low/high season).
quote: Low season (2 persons): €70 — High season (2 persons): €90... Drežniške Ravne 33, 5222 Kobarid... 600 m altitude.

claim: Žvanč is 7 km from Kobarid at the foot of Mt Krn, produces cheese over an open fire, keeps cows, sheep, and a local breed of goats, and runs cheese-making demos for guests.
quote: located in the small village of Drežniške Ravne at the foot of Mt. Krn... 7 km from Kobarid... cheese is produced on an open fire place... cows, sheep and a local breed of goats.

claim: Eco Kamp Koren sits on wooded terraces directly above the Soča river, offering wooden eco-chalets and Lushna glamping cabins; ~3 km from Kobarid centre.
quote: situated on a beautiful location on wooded terraces directly above the Soča River... wooden eco-lodge apartments... glamorous wooden glamping cottage called LILIJA (LUSHNA).

claim: Kamp Koren was one of the first Slovenian campsites awarded the EU Eco-label, received the 2010 Alan Rogers Award for excellent accommodations, and the 2016 'Slovenia Green Accommodation' title.
quote: Kamp Koren was one of the first Slovene campsites to be awarded the EU Eco-label... Alan Rogers Award in 2010... 2016 'Slovenia green accommodation'.

claim: Pristava Lepena keeps a stable of Lipizzaner and Andalusian horses and offers riding for all levels into Triglav National Park and the Soča Valley.
quote: All guests can ride these majestic white animals – from beginners to experts... horseback riding in the Soča Valley... Lipizzaners and Andalusians.

claim: Pristava Lepena is a cottage village in old Trentarian style on a plateau above the Soča in Triglav National Park; ~40 minutes' drive from Kobarid (≈25–30 km).
quote: picturesque plateau above the valley of the Soča River... built in the old Trentarian style... Kobarid World War I museum is 40 minutes away from Pristava Lepena.

claim: Tourist Farm Kranjc sits at 600 m beneath Mt Krn in Koseč, 6 km from Kobarid, just below Triglav National Park.
quote: altitude of 600 metres above sea level, just beneath Triglav National Park and only 6 km away from the historic town of Kobarid.

claim: Hiša Sonca is an apartment house in central Kobarid (≈100 m from the centre) with two apartments (Sonce, Luna) and two rooms (Krn, Matajur), a sauna, and a 2-person massage tub.
quote: Apartment and Rooms HISA SONCA, Kobarid... over 100m away from the center of Kobarid... apartment SONCE (for 7 people)... apartment LUNA... rooms KRN... MATAJUR... combined Finnish & infrared sauna.

claim: Hiša Kala is a single-floor renovated family-home apartment on historic Gregorčičeva street, with a private garden terrace, sole occupancy of the first floor, walking distance to Kobarid Museum and the Soča.
quote: renovated family home... spacious apartment takes over the whole 1st floor... only one in the house... terrace with garden view... 6-minute stroll from Napoleon's Bridge.

claim: Local Soča Valley taxi services are explicit Hiša Franko partners — drivers pick up from Bovec, Tolmin and Kobarid lodgings, wait through the 3–4 hour tasting menu, and return diners afterwards.
quote: We will provide professional service and transfer to the Hiša Franko... pickup about 2 hours and 15 minutes before your reservation time... driver will wait until you finish your meal (usually 3-4 hours).

claim: Hiša Franko's own FAQ confirms dinner reservation is the entry point; on-site rooms must be requested alongside the dining booking and are not auto-confirmed.
quote: select the 'I am also interested in booking a one-night stay' option after choosing the date of your dining reservation... room requests are not confirmed automatically.
